quote: A poor rendition of the original. Nothing innovative. Simply lazy and uninspiring.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: newtbam08
quote: After 20+ hours in game, I can definitively say that this one, if not the best game I’ve ever played. Compelling characters and a lived in world that keeps me coming back for more. Game mechanics that are truly amazing and a open world that is pushing the genre forward. I truly love this game.
